column1: # nginx-telego managed Nginx ownership registry v2
#   package   active file has a canonical package copy and may be repaired
#   generated active file is rendered from UCI/runtime state
#   required    file is expected on every installed system
#   conditional file may be absent when its managed feature is disabled
# source is an absolute canonical package path for package-owned files and the
# literal "renderer" for generated files. This registry only covers Nginx files
# owned by nginx-telego; unrelated administrator/application files are foreign.
